rows.notes: Page is undated but is the organizer's current page. It lists two closing times: 1:00 pm in the header and 2:00 pm in the body (market hours are 8-2). The phone (808-234-9421) and email (nscmkt@gmail.com) on the page match the market's contact info, so they may be the market's rather than the vendor's own. The market's site now lists a different contact (NSCountryMarket28@gmail.com, 808-954-1483), so the page may be partly outdated. The market address is 59-360 Kamehameha Hwy, Haleiwa, HI 96712 (Sunset Elementary School); no separate vendor address is given.
